limitations: Max hits come from NPC page infoboxes (first variants); where an NPC page had no max hit it is recorded as null.

Instance/cutscene/leave-or-teleport detail is only given where keyword-matched walkthrough lines state it (encounter_context_hints, low confidence); a full per-fight review is needed by the Threat Analyst for the quests the owner will actually do.
Prerequisite chains are the wiki's nested requirement lists (one extra level of prerequisite skill requirements checked); quest point totals of the owner are not in the brief.
Skill boostability per quest as flagged on each page; some pages leave the flag blank ('boostable flag not stated').

Facts about quests that need prerequisite quests with their own long chains (e.g. Legends' Quest, Dream Mentor, Troll Romance) are listed as missing quests but their individual rewards were not researched unless they give Thieving XP or a Thieving-usable lamp.
